subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **High up.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the **blank number 5** is **"high up."**
 
• The sentence suggests that the railways gave notice to the speaker to quit the shop, and the speaker tried to seek help from the old stationmaster and porter, but they could not do anything.
 
• Therefore, it implies that the decision to ask the speaker to quit the shop came from someone in a higher position of authority than the stationmaster and porter.
 
• The phrase **"high up"** means** in a position of authority, power, or influence. **
 
 
• **Example: **​The CEO of the company sits **high up** in the corporate hierarchy.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option** "high up"** is the most appropriate choice to fill in the blank.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **1) high up.**

Correct Paragraph:__ *My worries were increasing. The boy at the shop was becoming more clamorous. My sales were poor, as the railways (1) __were admitting__* *more peddlers on the platforms. My cash receipts were going down and my credit sales alone (2) __flourished__. The wholesale merchants who supplied me with goods stopped credit to me. The boy's method of account-keeping was so chaotic that I did not know whether I was moving forward or backward. He produced cash from the counter in a haphazard manner, and there (3) __were immense gaps__* *on the shelves all over the shop. The boy was probably pocketing money and eating off the stuff. With my credit at the wholesalers' gone, the public complained that nothing one wanted was ever available. Suddenly, the railways gave me notice to quit. I (4) __pleaded with__ the old stationmaster and porter, but they could do nothing; the order had come from **(5)** __**high up**__**. The shop was given to a new contractor.*
